label: US
full_name: General Instruction of the Roman Missal, with the Adaptations for the Dioceses of the United States of America
edition: Third Typical Edition, 2010 ICEL/USCCB translation with USCCB adaptations
episcopal_conference: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (USCCB)
promulgation_body: USCCB, with recognitio of the Holy See
latin_base: Institutio Generalis Missalis Romani, editio typica tertia, 2002
adaptations_method: Embedded directly in the paragraph text, signalled by 'In the Dioceses of the United States of America…'
notes: USCCB adaptations are embedded inline in the GIRM text rather than published as a separate document.
The US version uses 'color' (American spelling) vs 'colour' (UK).
Kneeling norms (§43): US mandates kneeling from Sanctus through EP Amen, and after Agnus Dei.
Communion posture (§160): standing is the US norm.
Servers' attire (§339): 'or other appropriate and dignified clothing' — broader than universal norm.
Vestments (§346): white or black at funerals; gold or silver on solemn occasions.
In force from the First Sunday of Advent, 27 November 2011.
